title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the joint communication on humanitarian aid (JOIN(2026)0025)
part_text: 11.Welcomes the EU’s commitment to strengthening advocacy and support for the protection sector, to strengthening the cost-effective and resilient delivery of humanitarian aid by reforming supply chains and maximising the value of EU humanitarian funding, and to strengthening humanitarian diplomacy in order to build strategic alliances with like-minded partners and wealthy regional actors, to make better use of resources and to implement more effective and results-oriented actions; is alarmed by the sharp rise in attacks on humanitarian workers, medical personnel and humanitarian infrastructure; calls on the Commission, the EEAS, EU delegations and the Member States to place women and girls at the centre of humanitarian preparedness and response efforts, and strengthen women’s full, equal and meaningful participation in all stages of peace processes, including in humanitarian responses and recovery efforts;
